groups.defect: Test cleanup is registered as testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove, using the literal "alias" instead of the created IDP's alias. This happens at line 381 (idp-alias-i) and line 425 (idp-alias-20), so the created IDPs leak into other tests.

answer.reasoning: Both suggestions are anchored at line 381. Each reports the same defect: the cleanup targets the literal alias "alias", so the created IDPs are never removed. Each also points out the same repeat at line 425. Neither one reports a defect or location the other lacks, so they clearly belong in one group. The judges disagree only on needsUnifiedComment. The fix needs two edits, at lines 381 and 425, but each suggestion already covers both places on its own. A merged comment therefore doesn't need to say more than either one already says, so I set the flag to false. Judge 1's reading, that two separate edit locations should make it true, is also defensible, which makes this a judgment call.
